title: Custom Soccer Ball with Number 07 Comforter Set, Machine W - Design 17
description:
Unleash the spirit of the game in your child's room with this exciting Jeminise Comforter Set, perfect for young soccer enthusiasts. Designed to inspire dreams of the field, this set combines comfort with a passion for soccer, making it an ideal gift for any fan.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Designed for young soccer enthusiasts, inspiring them to chase their dreams and fueling excitement for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy to Use: Features a hidden zipper and a smooth metal pull for effortless insertion or removal of the duvet.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Utilizes environmental protection techniques to prevent fading and ensure smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Machine Washable: Simple care; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat. Microfiber dries quickly and becomes fluffier.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, with optional pillowcases not detailed in the source.
  • Product Style: A modern soccer pattern designed to enhance a boy's room decor.
